Synopsis:
Dialog with harpers in Danthelon's Dancing Axe basement ambush. A number of doppelgangers have slaughered a Harper troop and stolen their faces, forcing the one surviving Harper to set Jaheira up for an ambush.We can see the trap coming, or pick up on Jaheira's hint that all is not right. Either way, it ends in combat.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_Axe_Harpers.json: This takes place in the Dancing Axe cellar Danthelon lends Jaheira as a Harper safe‑house; off‑screen her Harper cell has already been infiltrated and many members slaughtered by shapechangers who stole their faces. One terrified survivor (Geraldus) is present and uses a coded phrase — “Selûne’s Tears” — to try to warn Jaheira. Jaheira, recently hardened by assaults on mind‑flayer/Absolute agents, catches the code and subtly signals that these Harpers are impostors tied to the Absolute; a senior Harper (Hemm/Chelvin in the exchange) then turns the meeting hostile. The player may or may not have external confirmation (True Sight or other means); missing Jaheira’s hints leads immediately into the ambush and combat.
- WYR_Axe_Harpers_OM_Jaheira_OOM.json: Dialog with harpers in Danthelon's Dancing Axe basement ambush. A number of doppelgangers have slaughered a Harper troop and stolen their faces, forcing the one surviving Harper to set Jaheira up for an ambush.OOM version of this dialog that were made after the splitting of WYR_Axe_Harpers dialog.
- WYR_Axe_RealHarper_Alive.json: Dialog with the real harper in Danthelon basement after saving him from a doppelganger ambush. He tells us how Jaheira's Harpers were infiltrated and killed, while he was forced to lure her into a trap. Jaheira will want to dismiss Geraldus for his own safety, but the player can intervene.
- SCL_Drider_HarperCaster_000.json: A Harper, getting ready for a mission that will see them trying to kill a drider - a big, dangerous monster. Main path only available when group dialogue is unavailable. This Harper is boisterous and eager.
- WYR_Axe_AD_Ambush_RealHarper.json: At combat vs doppelgangers start, harper Geraldus has this AD.
